name: Jordi Baylina
description: Jordi Baylina is a blockchain engineer and researcher focused on Ethereum scalability and zero-knowledge technology. He is the founder of SilentSig and creator of ZisK, an open-source zkVM. Previously, he co-founded Polygon Hermez, led the development of Polygon zkEVM, and created the widely used open-source projects Circom and snarkJS.
